items.lede: The credit rating agency may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, the fourth-highest rating.
items.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks

items.lede: S&P Global Ratings says that it could lower Nvidia's credit rating because of various risks that it faces, including the smuggling allegations and the fact the lack of succession planning for its CEO.
items.title: Credit rating agency puts Nvidia on notice for possible downgrade
